profile.headline: Purdue University Mechanical Engineering Graduate
profile.summary: I am a Senior looking for available internships and Co-ops in order to build a strong relationship with your organization. As a mechanical engineering major, I am fascinated about understanding the mechanics behind how things operate. I admire the flexibility of mechanical engineers and I desire to understand the basics of Engineering.

positions.title: Process Engineer
positions.locationName: Iowa City, Iowa, United States · On-site

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.locationName: West Lafayette, Indiana, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Global Account Deputy Project Manager
positions.description:
•	Spearheaded the research and overhaul of global accounts project management websites and documentation, resulting in a 20% increase in user engagement and a 15% reduction in document retrieval time.
•	Engineered customized tools leveraging SharePoint and Tableau, which streamlined cross-departmental communication and project tracking improving team collaboration and reducing project delays by 30% and improving operations efficiency by 25%.
•	Developed tools to improve organizational process and communication (SharePoint, Tableau)
•	Gained experience with Honeywell standard project management tools (Projects, Cora, PPM)
•	Created resource documents to help make organization and gathering of information more effective
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Microsoft Project · cora · Yammer · SharePoint · Tableau · Project Portfolio Management

positions.title: Summer Analyst Intern
positions.description:
•	Collaborated and conducted a search for the role of VP of engineering for GoPro  and CTO for Game stop
•	Conducted 6 case studies and created Pitch Documents for rising tech companies
•	Navigated through complex software such as Thrive and Pitchbook and created numerous candidate profiles

positions.locationName: West Lafayette, Indiana, United States · On-site

positions.title: Library Aide
positions.description:
·   	Critically thought through problems that affected the library’s daily operations
·   	Provided support to the buildings' staff and Library Patrons

positions.title: Building Manager
positions.description:
·   	Supervised cross-team collaborations and team operations within various entities in the building leading to higher customer satisfaction from 200+ daily visitors
·   	Actively contributed to an 11% decrease in the COVID-19 positivity rate on Purdue’s campus through strict implementation of guidelines and protocols
·   	Critically thought through problems that affect the building’s daily operations

positions.title: Supply Quality Improvement Engineer
positions.description:
 Interned as a Supply Quality Improvement Engineer (SQIE)
 Developed Zero Defect Mentality Questionnaires (ZDM) for multiple specific Genset parts supplied to the industry
 Shadowed Manager to learn technical Procedures of the company
 Completed the SQIE Quality college, GD&T Fundamentals, Ethics and Project Management, Export Controls Training and the [M-2022] Preventing Sexual Harassment in the workplace
 Acquired multiple certificates in the 6Sigma & Continuous Improvement course
 Met with a supplier for a tour of the manufacturing plant

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
 Monitored development of materials and items purchased 
 Shadowed the company CEO for a month
 Partook and understood all procedures of the inventory department

positions.title: Software Engineer program manager Intern
positions.description:
•	Conducted system analysis resulting in a 17% decrease in software errors and enhanced overall system performance.
•	Engaged in projects and program development meetings, providing valuable insights that led to a 10% increase in timely completion of deliverables and adherence to project timelines.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Python (Programming Language) · Program Management

volunteerExperiences.description: During this period, I and my colleagues mentored a number of students from a less priviledged community. We mentored them in Math and English and served as informatory individuals.
